definitions.explanation: Describes something revered as spiritually pure or worthy of deep religious respect. Used for places, rituals, objects, and abstract concepts.

examples.japanese: ここは{神聖|しんせい}な{場所|ばしょ}です。
{神聖|しんせい}な{儀式|ぎしき}が{行|おこな}われた。
この{山|やま}は{古|ふる}くから{神聖|しんせい}な{場所|ばしょ}として{人々|ひとびと}に{崇|あが}められてきた。
examples.english: This mountain has been revered by people as a sacred place since ancient times.

notes:
{神聖|しんせい} is a na-adjective combining {神|しん} (god, divine) + {聖|せい} (holy). It describes things revered as spiritually pure.

FORMS:
- {神聖|しんせい}な + noun: sacred (modifier)
- {神聖|しんせい}だ: is sacred (predicate)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {神聖|しんせい}な{場所|ばしょ}: sacred place
- {神聖|しんせい}な{義務|ぎむ}: sacred duty
- {神聖|しんせい}な{権利|けんり}: sacred right
- {神聖|しんせい}にして{侵|おか}すべからず: sacred and inviolable (set phrase)
- {神聖|しんせい}ローマ{帝国|ていこく}: Holy Roman Empire

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {聖|せい}なる: holy, sacred — more literary and poetic
- {崇高|すうこう}: sublime, lofty — emphasizes elevated spiritual quality
- {神聖|しんせい} is also used figuratively for things treated with deep respect
